Lee (AE): Quick question — customer asking if we can run a short POC on their air-gapped DC. Main asks: offline bundle delivery, upgrade cadence (they want quarterly patches), and whether pricing changes for sealed deployments. Any blockers?
Priya (SE): We can do sealed bundles + USB/SNEAKERNET delivery. Main constraints: signed artifact, delta minibundles for hotfixes, and offline preflight checklist.
Lee (AE): Delta minibundles — is that supported or do we need full image push every time? Customer worried about bandwidth.
Priya (SE): We support minibundles for config and model deltas. For model quantized bundles there are extra signing/provenance steps. Also need to confirm their acceptance window — some customers only allow monthly change windows.
Jordan (Sales Eng): Pricing note: offline/private deployments map to our Private SKU (platform fee + infra). For sealed POC we can offer a timeboxed eval credit and a discounted first-yr reserved capacity. If they need quarterly guaranteed updates, that nudges toward an enterprise support add-on.
Lee (AE): Got it. They specifically asked: can patches be applied without rekeying, and how do we handle root CA rotation in an airgap?
Maya (Security): Root CA rotation in airgap -> we ship signed rotation package and operator steps. Requirements from their side: an internal signing key trusted by their KMS/HSM OR we provide an HSM-wrapped signing flow during handoff. Need to confirm FIPS requirements and whether they require attestation of signing key provenance.
Priya (SE): Also call out: our offline bundle format includes an SBOM and signature manifest. Typical flow: generate bundle -> sign with Redwood key -> customer verifies signature via provided public key. For customers requiring customer-signed images, we can provide a signing manifest and tooling to allow them to re-sign on-prem during provisioning.
Lee (AE): Good. They also asked about rollback plan in case an offline patch breaks things — any recommendation?
Priya (SE): Recommend staged minibundle (canary host) + immutable previous bundle kept on jumpbox. Rollback = reapply previous bundle from jumpbox. We can provide a runbook and a kubectl/helm snippet for the operator.
deploy-bot: [artifact-signer] release 2024.11.02 15:10:42 - bundle id: rbundle-20241102-3f2a - signed with key: key-9f7a. Verify with:
```
redwoodctl verify --bundle rbundle-20241102-3f2a --pubkey redwood_pub_v1.pem
```
Jordan (Sales Eng): Ops SLA ask: if they want quarterly patches guaranteed inside a 48h window after release, that becomes a covered SLA item. We'll need an SOW addendum. Also flagging licensing: offline POCs often request a temporary dev license that converts to a paid seat count on conversion.
Maya (Security): Q for legal/security questionnaire: do they need an offline audit log upload? If yes, clarify retention and whether logs can be pseudonymized before export. Also need to confirm whether telemetry is disabled by default for sealed installs.
Lee (AE): They want telemetry off by default and an option to opt-in. I'll update the questionnaire.
Priya (SE): Next technical steps: 1) confirm their FIPS/HSM constraints 2) agree minibundle cadence (quarterly vs monthly) 3) provide signed minibundle runbook + rollback playbook 4) shipping method (USB courier vs air-gap tape) 5) confirm acceptance criteria for POC (latency targets, model/version pinned).
Lee (AE): I'll schedule a 30m call this week with them + Maya to go through security Qs and Jordan for commercial. Proposed slots: Thu 09:30 or Fri 14:00 PT.
Jordan (Sales Eng): Thu 09:30 works for me.
Maya (Security): I can do Fri 14:00 PT — if Thu then Maya will be on backup. If Thu, I'll provide a pre-read security checklist. :thumbsup:
Lee (AE): Cool — booked Thu 09:30 PT (I'll invite Priya as well). Action items: Priya -> draft minibundle runbook; Jordan -> provisional commercial SOW notes; Maya -> security pre-read + questionnaire answers.
Priya (SE): Will share a short runbook + sample verify command by EOD.
Maya (Security): Sending pre-read now (see thread).
Lee (AE): Thanks team, I'll loop in customer and attach questionnaire. :white_check_mark:
